text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B after a large gain, but its gain relative to my cost is not a reason by itself to sell; I should judge each trade by its future prospects and role in the whole portfolio.","I should not let an unrealized loss make me hold on just to avoid admitting a mistake, or let loss aversion distort decisions; use consistent, forward-looking criteria for both winners and losers.","A few months of price moves do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term changes and make deliberate decisions based on my plan."]}
